approval.rationale: Broken, angular dark fieldstones in rough courses, half sunk in a continuous carpet of short dark green moss, with no tufts: on the ruins' broken copings and floors it reads as a moss-grown wall top, darker than the castle stone below it. Verified in game on the Old Fort's ruined stretch, Thornwatch, the Old Cloister and a roofless chapel.
limitations: Stones are laid in level rows, so a large moss floor (the ruined tower's) reads slightly as a pattern of courses from the steep camera.
The moss is one even dark green with no dry or brown patches, ferns or grass.
The stones carry Qwen's baked top-left relief shading.
